description.narrative: Funding under this activity represents Australian Centre of International Agricultural Research appropriated funds that, at the time of recording, are yet to be committed to aid research activities. For some periods negative transactions may be recorded. These negative transactions represent a reallocation of funds to an identified activity rather than a reduction in assistance.
